description: Saving the recovery file at the key receipt does not clear the 'key hasn't been backed up' banner; the user must save the same file again from the Files tab.
expected: Saving the file at the receipt counts as a backup, banner not shown (or shows a calm info line).
actual: Red banner appears immediately after the user did what the receipt asked.
suggested_fix: Record backup method 'file' when Save recovery key succeeds at the receipt.

description: After creating an agent, the 'Connect an agent' card with the instruction to paste into the agent is collapsed to its title, with no visible chevron, so the user does not see what to give the agent.
expected: Card stays open (or opens) until the first key exists.
actual: Only the heading 'Connect an agent' remains; the instruction is hidden.
suggested_fix: Default the details to open while there are zero keys, and show a disclosure marker.

description: From the empty-drive state, 'Connect an agent' lands on a disabled '+ New API key' and 'Create an agent first', requiring agent creation and key creation before any instruction can be used; about 12 actions for an ideal 5.
expected: One 'Connect an agent' screen that offers the copy-paste instruction (agent self-setup) first.
actual: Detour through agent creation, key creation and secret-saving dialogs.
suggested_fix: Lead with the llms.txt instruction and make agent/key creation an advanced option.

description: Clicking 'Save recovery key' in the receipt gives no confirmation (the download does happen), and Escape is silently ignored with no close button.
expected: Button text changes to 'Saved' or a short notice appears; a visible hint why Escape does not close.
actual: Dialog is visually unchanged after saving.
suggested_fix: Show 'Recovery file saved' beside the button; tick the checkbox hint.

description: Empty state shows two buttons for the same action ('Create your first drive' and '+ New drive'), and the 01/02/03 steps look clickable but are plain text.
expected: One CTA; steps are labelled as a checklist.
suggested_fix: Hide the header '+ New drive' while zero drives exist.

description: The drive tile showed '0 B · 0 files' while the table below already listed the agent's file, until another refresh.
actual: Tile lags the table by one load.
suggested_fix: Refresh usage when the file list reloads.

description: The drive key box in the receipt is about 75px tall for a single 43-character line.
